faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Get answers for questions before you contact us.
faq.q1: How does the inquiry process work?
faq.a1: Browse our catalog or choose a pre-assembled Solution Package, add items to your Quote List, and submit your inquiry. Our team reviews your request and sends detailed pricing — no payment is required upfront.
faq.q2: Can I visit a showroom before ordering?
faq.a2: Yes, we welcome showroom visits by appointment. Contact our team to schedule a visit at your convenience.
faq.q3: What payment methods do you accept?
faq.a3: We accept bank transfers, cheques, and corporate purchase orders. Payment terms are discussed during the proposal stage.
faq.q4: Do you handle large-scale procurement projects?
faq.a4: Absolutely. We specialize in bulk procurement and project-scale deliveries, with dedicated project managers to oversee every stage.
